question: Where can I get the current land-use and zoning plans of Spain as geometry, with land classification and the planning instrument they belong to?

answer.summary: There is no single national zoning geometry. The ministry SIU (WFS/REST) gives national land-class polygons and the planning instrument in force per municipality. Real zoning (calificacion) and the instrument per polygon exist only in regional services; ten autonomous communities were tested (Valencia is the most complete), six have no usable public geometry service found. Data are informative, not legally binding.
main_caveats: Urbanismo is a regional competence: each region has its own schema, class codes and refresh date, so nationwide results need a per-region mapping.
Regional and SIU layers are informative; legal force lies in the approved instrument published in the regional registry or official gazette.
SIU instrument is municipal only (Plan General, Normas Subsidiarias, Delimitacion de Suelo, Sin Planeamiento); 1357 of 8217 municipal polygons have no planning.
mivau.gob.es answers 403 to automated clients and its shapefile zips returned 404 on 2026-11-16; use the mapas.fomento.gob.es services instead.
Six regions lack a found public geometry service (Andalucia, Galicia, Cantabria, Asturias, La Rioja, Castilla-La Mancha viewer-only); Extremadura listed service is dead.
answer.confidence_reason: Ten services tested with live counts and fields; six regions only searched or blocked, and the SIU data date and licence are not documented.

how_to_use.example_result: {"properties":{"ProvINE":"48080","ClaseSuelo":"SUELO NO URBANIZABLE","NuclRural":"0","FechaBaja":"99999999","AreaLambert":8924953.337},"geometry":{"type":"MultiPolygon"}} (second record: SISTEMAS GENERALES Y OTROS, same municipality). Instrument query: https://mapas.fomento.gob.es/arcgis/rest/services/SIU/Planeamiento_Vigente/MapServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&resultRecordCount=3&f=json returned CodINE 17035 Cámós, FiguraVigente "Normas Subsidiarias", FechaFigura 2006, UrlLink https://dtes.gencat.cat/rpucportal/#/inici
steps: Page through OGC_Clases_Suelo with count/startIndex (hits query gave numberMatched 21791); outputFormat=GEOJSON returns EPSG:4326 although the service default CRS is EPSG:3857.

Query Planeamiento_Vigente layer 0 by REST (maxRecordCount 2000, page with resultOffset) to get FiguraVigente per municipality; field names are prefixed GIS_SIU.SIU.plan_mun. and the INE code is GIS_SIU.SIU.EGRN_recintos_municipales_inspire.CodINE.
Join ClaseSuelo polygons to the instrument by municipality: OGC_Clases_Suelo.ProvINE equals CodINE.
Follow UrlLink to the regional registry for the instrument document and for real zoning.
reading_traps: ProvINE holds the 5-digit municipality code, not a province code.
Instrument is municipal only: Plan General 2781, Normas Subsidiarias 2798, Delimitacion de Suelo 1195, Sin Planeamiento 1357 (FechaFigura 0), null 86 of 8217 rows.
Clases_Suelo has 5900 municipality codes while Planeamiento_Vigente has 8217 polygons: a municipality can have an instrument and no classes.
Classes are harmonised across regions; ClaseSuelo is not the regional legal wording and the SIU is informative only.

Ministry page https://www.mivau.gob.es/urbanismo-y-suelo/sistema-de-informacion-urbana answers 403 (pagina bloqueada) to automated clients; the shapefile zips it lists (cdn.mivau.gob.es/.../clases_suelo_20240524.zip) answered 404 on 2026-11-16, and the datos.gob.es record (396 MB zip, 2022) has a user comment that the link fails.
Default WFS CRS is EPSG:3857; Shape.STArea__ is in that CRS (inflated at Spanish latitudes), AreaLambert is the usable area.

steps: Choose the region from the member list; each has its own service and field names.
Page the WFS with count/startIndex (Valencia hits: 122840) or download the shapefile zip (Catalonia, Aragon FPM, Canarias).
Valencia: default CRS EPSG:25830; csv output carries WKT.
Use the instrument field (expediente, cod_plan, c_instrum, CODIPLA, plan) to link each polygon to its planning instrument; names and codes are not harmonised across regions.
reading_traps: No common schema: class codes differ (Valencia SU/SUZ/SNU-C/SNU-P, Aragon SDUD/SENE, Madrid DS_CLASIF_GEN text, Catalonia SUD...).

Valencia Planeamiento.Clasificacion and Planeamiento.Zonificacion are the same coverage (both 122840): clas_suelo and zon_suelo are two fields of one polygon; 9567 polygons are "MUNICIPIO SIN PLANEAMIENTO" with expediente 00000000 and clas_suelo 0.
Catalonia: qualification shapefiles are split by comarca; CLAS and QUAL carry no instrument name.
Madrid has several vintages (REF_19, REF_23, REF_25); REF_25 is the newest listed in the WFS.
Aragon and Navarra WFS include municipal-level instrument layers (FPM, PlanUrbMun) next to the classification.
CyL, Valencia, Madrid, Baleares state the data are informative only; legal force lies in the approved instrument.

problems: Extremadura GetCapabilities URL redirects to a 404 page.

recipe: Take the plan code or link from the regional layer (Murcia Enlace_BORM, Valencia url_abs, Aragon pdf, Baleares URL, Navarra URLSIUN/URLBON) or from SIU Planeamiento_Vigente UrlLink.
Open the document: example BORM id 72217 is a 3-page PDF (pdftotext -layout) with the approval order, expediente number and approval date (1997-12-30), matching validFrom 1997-12-30 in the WFS.
Extract the approval date, instrument type and expediente from the text; the text of the classification maps themselves is in annexed planos, not in the gazette text.
Where no layer exists (Andalucia, Galicia, Cantabria, Asturias, La Rioja), the land class is read from planos de clasificacion in the municipal plan PDF; this was not tested.
